title: Incrementing the Register Once
statement: For either choice of the program parameter, every input bit string $x$, and all natural numbers $n$ and $p$, the program starting at its bump label with its single register equal to $n$ and input position $p$ reaches its scan label after one step, with register value $n+1$ and input position still $p$, adding no output. This holds for every output string already printed.
hypotheses_covered: The program parameter is a Boolean choice
The input is an arbitrary bit string
